ambiguities.explanation: The phrase '100% of the time' lacks a measurable boundary, making it unclear what percentage of time the service can be temporarily unavailable during maintenance windows and infrastructure upgrades without violating the requirement.
possible_interpretations: The payment service is available for 99.999% of the total time (5 minutes of downtime per year).
The payment service is available for 99.9% of the total time (43 minutes and 20 seconds of downtime per hour).
